what.text: Venezuelan people moved from Venezuela to host countries in Latin America and the Caribbean.
In 2025, host countries included Colombia with 2810778 people, Peru with 1098014, Chile with 662504, Brazil with 549534, and Ecuador with 432888.
The number of Venezuelan people in need of international protection reached 6042706 in 2025.

why.text: The sources don't say why people moved from Venezuela.
No conflict episodes or event descriptions are recorded in the data.

when.text: In 2018, there were 21047 refugees, 464223 asylum seekers, and 2592947 people in need of international protection.
By 2025, the number of refugees was 417010, asylum seekers were 1181156, and people in need of international protection reached 6042706.
New disaster displacements included 31707 movements in 2018 and 32592 movements in 2021.

how.text: Refugees are counted at the end of the year under UNHCR mandate.
Asylum seekers are people who asked for international protection whose claims have not been decided at the end of the year.
People in need of international protection are outside their country and not counted as refugees or asylum seekers.
